# telnyx_agent_gateway_models (Data Source)

The models an Agent Gateway serves.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The gateway id.

### Optional

- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `agent_gateway_models` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_models))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_models"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_models`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) The model's ID on the instance.
- `model` (String) The Telnyx Inference model behind it, such as `zai-org/GLM-5.3-Flash`.
- `name` (String) The name a request uses, such as `GLM-5.3-Flash`.
- `priced_at` (String) When the price was last set.
- `pricing` (Attributes) A model's price in USD per million tokens. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--agent_gateway_models--pricing))

<a id="nestedatt--agent_gateway_models--pricing"></a>
### Nested Schema for `agent_gateway_models.pricing`

Read-Only:

- `cached_input` (Number) USD per million cached input tokens.
- `currency` (String) Always `USD`.
- `input` (Number) USD per million input tokens.
- `output` (Number) USD per million output tokens.
- `unit` (String) Always `1M_tokens`.
